description: An installed app's window opens the folder it is handed at launch with the page's own engine (ADR-0540). Launching permits the window into that folder's scope; the folder plugin then grants it the directory, reads and changes it, and runs the folder's Git itself. Approving an app trusts it fully, so this is wiring, not a sandbox. The window listens for the folder plugin's change event, epicenter-folder://changed.
